title: Presumptuous Attack and Defeat at Hormah
description: After the Lord had commanded the people to turn toward the wilderness, they acknowledged their sin but presumptuously went up into the hill country to fight against the Lord's command. The Amorites came out, pursued them like bees, and struck them down in Seir as far as Hormah. The people wept before the Lord, but he did not listen to them, and they remained for a long time at Kadesh.
